title: Subcortical responses to music and speech are alike while cortical responses diverge
description: EEG recordings from 22 analyzed normal-hearing adults (24 enrolled) listening to clicks, music, and speech, collected to derive auditory brainstem responses (ABR) from continuous natural stimuli by deconvolution. The dataset compares subcortical and cortical responses to six music genres and six speech types. Raw BrainVision EEG files, event annotations, and the audio stimuli are included.
methods_description: Participants sat in a sound-isolating booth and heard stimuli through ER-2 insert earphones at 65 dB SPL on average. Phase one presented ten one-minute click trials. Phase two presented 12 s clips of 12 stimulus types (six music genres, six speech types), 40 trials each in shuffled order with 0.5 s pauses. EEG was recorded in BrainVision format, and stimulus presentation was controlled with expyfun.
